prompt: Create a coordinated typography refinement mockup for the existing Korean TripLOG travel planner. Show three complete mobile screens side by side: “나의 여행”, “여행 리포트”, and “설정”. Preserve the existing white background, dark ink #0b1020, lemon yellow #fff05a, sky blue #bce6fb, pink #f7afc7, thin dark borders, small hard offset shadows, outline icons, and compact TRIPLOG wordmark with pink LOG backing. Refine the existing interface rather than changing its design language. Use a consistent compact Korean sans-serif hierarchy: page titles 22px, trip names 18px, section and list titles 15px, body and action text 14px, labels and helper text 13px, metadata 12px, headline amounts 22px, editable fields 16px. Use calmer font weights, clear line heights, 44px primary controls, balanced vertical spacing, and readable wrapping. My trips screen: subtitle, upcoming/past tabs, one selected trip with destination and dates, edit icon, “여행 열기”, other trips, yellow “새 여행 만들기” action. Report screen: total expense, budget caption, expense/itinerary tabs, category donut with readable labels and amounts, payment date trend, blue PDF action. Settings screen: subtitle, profile row, grouped travel settings, sharing toggles, record management and logout. Keep the same five bottom navigation items “개요”, “일정”, “지출”, “리포트”, “더보기”, header sync and menu controls. No destination photographs. Match typography and component proportions across all three screens.
